color_to_name: convert a phyre simulation color ID integer to its lowercase string name
color_to_id: convert a color name string to its phyre simulation color ID integer
SolutionTier: use the SolutionTier IntEnum to classify phyre tasks into tiers like BALL or RAMP
ROLE_TO_COLOR_ID: look up the color ID for a given object role such as DYNAMIC_SUBJECT or STATIC
ALL_OBJECT_TYPES: check if a shape name like ball or poly is a valid phyre object type
